Does climate change exist? Yes. Any educated person can tell you that. Earth's climate is always fluctuating.

Does anthropogenic global warming exist? Maybe. It's plausible to me that humans' greenhouse gas emissions may be increasing Earth's temperature. It's also plausible that it has no effect whatsoever.

Does catastrophic anthropogenic global warming exist? Almost certainly not. While I think global warming might exist, I doubt that it's significant and I highly doubt that it's significant enough to cause serious harm. A moderate warming (maybe half a degree Centigrade or so) would probably be beneficial anyhow.
